dedupeText: fiery portrait album cover red hair wet hair warm lighting laughing portrait sans serif typography high key background the chaotic texture of the wet hair strands contrasts with the smooth high key skin tones the warm red and orange hues of the hair dominate the color story against a neutral backdrop typography is placed in the negative space to the right balancing the heavy visual weight of the hair on the left combine a high key candid portrait featuring a strong textural element like wet hair with minimalist right aligned humanist typography and a single character color accent

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-key portrait of a laughing woman with vibrant, wet, copper-red hair strands obscuring parts of her face, set against a warm, off-white background with clean, modern typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The chaotic texture of the wet hair strands contrasts with the smooth, high-key skin tones.
The warm red and orange hues of the hair dominate the color story against a neutral backdrop.
Typography is placed in the negative space to the right, balancing the heavy visual weight of the hair on the left.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a tight close-up, filling the left two-thirds of the frame, angled slightly towards the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's open-mouthed laugh and the bright highlights on the wet hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye follows the flow of the hair from the top left down across the face, leading to the text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant off-white negative space on the right side provides room for the title and artist name.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Copper-red and orange (hair) provide the primary visual energy.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white/cream (background) provides a clean field for the subject.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black and a single red character in the typography provide sharp focal points.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the hair versus low saturation in the skin and background; high-key value overall.

letterConstructionRules: Consistent stroke weight with slight humanist modulation
Mixed case for the artist name; all-caps with one lowercase exception for the title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'r' in the title is lowercase and colored red to contrast with the surrounding black uppercase letters.

treatment.fill: Black with subtle white drop shadow

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Humanist sans for the name paired with a more geometric, spaced-out sans for the title.

preserve: The red lowercase 'r' in the title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the humanist proportions and clean terminals.
Provides the slight stroke modulation seen in the artist name.
Good for the geometric, wide-tracked title text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key, warm-toned close-up photograph of a woman with wet, vibrant copper-red hair laughing. The hair should have distinct, thin strands crossing over her face. The background is a soft, off-white cream color with a slight warm glow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in the top right using a black humanist sans-serif with a subtle white shadow. Add the album title in the bottom right using a wide-tracked geometric sans-serif in all caps, except for one lowercase letter colored bright red.

verificationChecks: Is the hair texture wet and stringy?
Is the lighting warm and high-key?
Is there a single red lowercase letter in the title?

adjustableVariables: Amount of hair covering the face
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red hair doesn't look like blood.
Verify the drop shadow on the top text is subtle and doesn't look dated.
Check that the 'r' in the title is the only red element in the text.
Confirm the expression is a genuine laugh, not a grimace.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key candid portrait featuring a strong textural element (like wet hair) with minimalist, right-aligned humanist typography and a single-character color accent.
